title: “Full Auto Buff” Makes My Companions the Strongest in the World ~Unconsciously Unrivaled Just by Being There~
description:
One of a kind in the world - unique skills to last a lifetime. 
Slad, who possesses "Fully Automatic Support" and "Fully Automatic Weakening," was fired from his party one day after being treated as an obstacle by the heroes. "Well, I guess they can do it without me." 
Slad tries to live a carefree adventurer's life with an elf girl, Echika. But, without him, the heroic party struggles and the world is on the verge of extinction!

An unwitting hero's tale woven by Slade, with his ultimate skills, and his companions.
The curtain rises here-!!
author: Epina
